name: limit_anchor_on_the_fillet_border
why: ENTRY Z-C21.2, finding C2-1 of the audit completion: the twin of `limit_anchor_on_the_chamfer_border`, which for the fillet had NEVER been seen to fire. The check of risk 9 looks at the other face of the edge with IFace2.Normal, and IFace2~Normal.html says: «If the face is not a planar face, then this property returns 0,0,0». A fillet is a cylinder: Normal (0,0,0), cosine 0 like a true perpendicular wall, and the tangent edge of the fillet passed for a sharp edge. The hole would have gone behind the fillet at every change of radius, with no error.
defect_caught: The same part and the same anchor as the chamfer case, with an R5 fillet in place of the 5 chamfer: the edge between the front face and the fillet is at x = 95, z = 20, is straight, runs along Y and lies in the plane of the face. On the old library the hole is made (the anchor «holds»); on the new one it is refused because the other face is curved and, at the edge, tangent to the front one: the normal of the fillet at the midpoint of the edge (ISurface.EvaluateAtPoint) is that of the face. A curved face that meets the face at 90 degrees stays a sharp edge and is not refused.

expect.tolerance_why: 480000 minus (25 - pi*25/4)*120 = 643.806: pi inside, the twentieth covers the rounding

message_includes: on the border of a fillet
